hazards.hazard: the draft states medicines or doses, risk management, consent or capacity, or what to do in a crisis
hazards.how: any section of those kinds the composer writes is cut from the text and named in it, against agentic_core.api.care.CLINICIAN_ONLY_SECTIONS; the prompt asks for them only as questions for a professional
hazards.residual: a clinical statement written outside such a section, under another heading, is not cut

hazards.hazard: a history, a preference, a responsible person or a date is invented
hazards.how: UNGUARDED: the prompt says to write NOT SUPPLIED and invent nothing, and nothing checks the draft against what was supplied

hazards.hazard: the draft is read as a care plan that someone reviewed
hazards.how: a note that it is a draft organiser reviewed by nobody is appended to the text itself, so it travels with a copy

hazards.hazard: a score is stated that differs from the published table's
hazards.how: the score is computed in-house from the published table and returned first, and the narrative is told not to recompute it
hazards.residual: the narrative's own figures are not checked against the computed score

hazards.hazard: a retired instrument (the falls count) is used
hazards.how: the request is refused, naming the replacement its publisher issued; nothing is computed or composed

hazards.hazard: an instrument this platform does not hold is interpreted under a name nobody published
hazards.how: an id the catalogue does not hold is refused, listing the tools it does hold

hazards.hazard: a score withheld on its owner's terms is computed
hazards.how: the request is refused with the owner's terms; nothing is computed or composed

hazards.hazard: a person in immediate danger reads process guidance before calling for help
hazards.how: the emergency line opens the text, fixed and never composed, whatever served the rest

hazards.hazard: a concern about a child is handled on the adult route
hazards.how: the text says, second, that this form is the adult route and where a child's concern goes instead
hazards.residual: nothing reads the concern to detect that it is about a child

hazards.hazard: the route of another nation or framework is given as England's
hazards.how: any other jurisdiction is refused, with where to turn instead

hazards.hazard: a specific individual is identified or accused as a conclusion
hazards.how: UNGUARDED: only the prompt asks for no individual to be identified or accused; nothing checks the text

hazards.hazard: a detail is invented, or a part that was not supplied is filled
hazards.how: UNGUARDED: the prompt asks for NOT SUPPLIED and invents nothing; nothing checks the draft against what was supplied

hazards.hazard: the draft is taken as sent, received or a clinical record
hazards.how: every answer says it has not been reviewed, sent or received and is not a clinical record

hazards.hazard: a person's own text is read as an instruction, or a heading in it as a section the answer must have
hazards.how: what the person recorded is handed over as material, marked as data, and cut only at the helper (W859)
hazards.residual: a model may still follow an instruction inside the material; marking it as data does not prevent that

hazards.basis: 14 hazards across the Care tools: 11 linked to a guard found in the code now, 3 unguarded. An instruction written into a prompt is not counted as a guard. Open log (Owner ruling 2026-10-12): an entry is added when a hazard is found.

status.evidence_basis: which resource is listed first and which one served the last recorded completion. Configuration - what is configured, declared or reachable; below level 1 and not a statement about behaviour
status.mode_note: mode follows the most recent completion that actually SERVED (a successful recorded row) when history exists, prediction only until then — the two disagree when a listed model keeps failing, or is disabled by configuration and skipped
status.floor_active_basis: no successful completion has been recorded yet; predicted from whether a real model is listed
status.floor_note: The deterministic native floor is serving — honest structured reasoning, NOT an LLM. Run a local Ollama model (or enable an external accelerant) for generative prose.
status.guarantee: Workstation always produces a real, structured result from its OWN resources with NO external dependency; external providers are optional accelerants (flag-gated by AI_ALLOW_EXTERNAL).
